about: Pasted plans in other people's notations, written and labelled by a separate agent that saw only the catalogue (2026-11-10). holdout was scored blind once before the parser was tuned on dev. tables: pasted tables (spreadsheet cells with tabs, markdown), written the same way on 2026-11-11 and scored blind once before the table reader was tuned on them.
